title: Marco Steenbergen
text:
Hailing from the Netherlands, I have bounced between Europe and North America in pursuit of one abiding question: how do people—politicians and citizens alike—arrive at their political judgments and decisions? The search has taken me to the intersection of political science and psychology, with rigorous quantitative methods as my instruments of choice. Increasingly, those methods draw on computational social science, and this blend of political science, psychology, and computation now defines my work. I have ranged across many topics, but my current interests center on theoretical and methodological approaches to choice modeling, polarization in complex ideological landscapes, AI and political cognition, and AI in social science research methods. I am co-editor of Advances in Political Psychology.
This site collects my CV, teaching materials, software, and working papers. For occasional longer-form writing, subscribe to my Substack, Augmented Inquiry.
